$comment: Vocabulary the JD analyser uses. Data, not code: to teach the engine a new phrase, add it here. Every `capabilities` key must exist in src/data/capabilities.json (the build checks). A phrase is matched case-insensitively; Latin phrases match on word boundaries, Japanese phrases match as substrings. `weight` is how strongly one occurrence points at that capability — 1.5 for phrases that only mean this, 1 for ordinary ones, 0.5 for words that appear in every posting.
